name: app-workspace

workspaces.//packages: Globs, never literals: every member is contributed by a capability, so the set has to follow selection. bun hard-errors on a listed path that does not exist (`error: Workspace not found "apps/web"`) but is happy with a glob matching nothing, and skips a matched directory with no package.json — which is what keeps the Python modules `apps/api` and `apps/worker` out. The vendored `@mistral/*` packages under packages/ts/ belong to the `mistral-design-system` capability; packages/ts/README.md documents them and the `overrides` block below.

//overrides: Every capability package peer-depends on `@tanstack/react-query` at `^5` and dev-depends on it at the same range. The CLI vendors them as `file:` deps, so bun installs those dev deps nested, and `^5` floats to a newer patch than the exact version apps/web pins -- two versions, so nothing hoists. Two copies is not a size problem: each has its own `QueryClientContext`, so a hook inside a capability package throws `No QueryClient set` under the app's own provider. Pin it here, next to the other cross-package singletons.
